# Should you buy missing National Insurance years?

> Free UK State Pension checker for 2026/27: your State Pension age, projected qualifying years, whether to buy voluntary Class 3 National Insurance years, the cost, the extra weekly pension and the payback. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
